title: Frontier
description: What the interviewer is given for one turn, read from the PM mode's records.

namedBy.description: Who the start request said gave the words; no script can tell whether that is so.

asked.description: Each time words were given for the work, by whom and when.

items.description: A question, as schemas/question.json gives it.

asks.description: The questions this turn asks, in order.

lookUp.description: The facts this turn may look up.

opened.description: The token frontier wrote in the records when it opened this turn; record keeps the turn only with it.
